title: FBI Photo A004
sensor_system_note: A-series — different sensor system from B-series. Small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row, NO timestamp visible, '5' scale mark only. A001-A006 are aerial terrain views (sensor pointed down at ground). A007 is the polarity-anomaly frame (sky background, bright specular target). A008 is sky background with normal dark-on-light polarity. Treat as adjacent-not-paired with B-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white thermal or infrared targeting display with overlaid reticle
pages.description: A grayscale image resembling a thermal or infrared camera view of rugged terrain with diagonal ridges and scattered dark speckling suggesting vegetation or rocks. A crosshair reticle is centered on the image with horizontal and vertical graduated scales marked by tick marks; a numeral '5' is visible on the right side of the horizontal scale. A small solid black dot appears just below and right of the reticle center. Numerous solid black rectangular bars overlay the top edge and both left and right sides of the image, appearing to redact or mask portions of the frame. The background terrain fades to black along the left edge.

observations.claim: A targeting crosshair with graduated tick-mark scales is centered in the image

pages.reticle_style: small '+' reticle with horizontal tick row (numbered '5' mark on right). Does NOT match B-series large full-frame crosshair.
